First stable release of OpenElixir-02, custom firmware for the Erica Synths LXR-02 drum machine.

> Tested on hardware by the author. OpenElixir-02 is not official Erica Synths firmware and is not
> affiliated with or approved by Erica Synths. Install it at your own risk.

## New since 0.2

- **Load a single voice from another kit**, also from other projects: hold **LOAD** and press one of
  the step buttons 1-7 (Drum 1 ... OP HH). Choose the kit with the encoder, press the encoder button
  to load the voice. The menu stays open, so you can try several kits.
- **Kits from and into other projects:** "Change Project" below kit 0 in the load and save kit menus.
  A kit loaded from another project replaces the current sound without writing anything; a kit saved
  into another project keeps its name.
- **Limiter switch:** the output limiter from 0.1 can be switched off in the config menu ("lim",
  2nd page). Off gives exactly the stock mix, which clips.
- **Safer project save:** a project is written into a new folder and replaces the saved one only when
  everything was written. A failed save (e.g. a full card) or switching off during the save no longer
  loses the saved project. The card needs free space for a second copy of the project (a few hundred
  KB).

Details: [docs/ENGINES.md](https://github.com/tunefish777/openelixir-02/blob/v1.0/docs/ENGINES.md).

## Stock firmware bugs fixed

Most of these were found in the firmware review by jhw in
[erica-synths/lxr-desktop-app#3](https://github.com/erica-synths/lxr-desktop-app/issues/3). Thanks!

**MIDI and sequencer**
- Every sequencer note was sent twice on MIDI out (stuck notes on some synths).
- The per-voice MIDI CC channel filter checked the wrong voice's channel.
- MIDI clock arriving in the middle of another message corrupted it (also on MIDI thru).
- Bank select (CC 0) could select a kit past the last one and didn't update the current kit.
- Bank select and the NRPN control CCs were recorded as step automation.
- A song starting with LOOP played a nonexistent pattern; at a song's end MIDI stop wasn't sent and
  the front panel still showed the sequencer running.
- Internal tempo ran up to 0.2 % fast.
- SHIFT + CONFIG made the next step press set the length of all tracks.
- Holding a step showed voice 1's automation; parameter locks on later held steps erased the
  automation of voice 1 or 2.

**Sound**
- Pitch EG slope 127 silenced the oscillator.
- The snare and the mono compressor path wrapped around (loud crackle) instead of clipping.
- The end of a project save interrupted the audio while the sequencer was running.

**Memory corruption** (random glitches, wrong values or crashes)
- NRPNs 128-255 (e.g. the mutes) wrote past a value table.
- Recording, rolls and flams used an invalid step while the sequencer was stopped.
- SHIFT + held select button armed steps far past the 64.
- Values out of range (from MIDI or old kits) read past the menu's name tables; an FX type set too
  high via modulation broke the FX page.
- USB-MIDI sent bytes from past its buffer and wrote into program memory before USB was connected.
- The RAT distortion read past its table; a bad value there stayed until reboot.
- Unchecked track lengths and kit/project numbers from files.

**SD card**
- Failed or incomplete saves (e.g. a full card) reported success; one error path blocked the card
  until a reboot. Kit and pattern saves now show an error.
- Project save, RELOAD and clear kit used the kit last scrolled to on the load/save page instead of
  the current kit.
- A new or cleared kit (init kit) had its parameters shifted by 8 and kept the last 8 (FX settings,
  morph) from the previous kit.
- A damaged settings file (glo.cfg) left the settings half overwritten; at boot the defaults weren't
  applied.
- Saving a kit, pattern or song under a new name left the old file behind, and loading could pick
  it up instead.
- A damaged pattern file left the pattern half loaded; patterns from older firmware kept the
  flams/shifts of the pattern loaded before.

Issues of the stock firmware that are kept on purpose (to keep the stock sound) or not fixed:
[docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md](https://github.com/tunefish777/openelixir-02/blob/v1.0/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).

## Also included

Everything from 0.1 and 0.2: assignable voice engines (SHIFT + KIT), about 10 % less CPU load, no
more hard clipping in the mix, and the fixes for the ping-pong delay and the ".SNG" kit name.

## Installing

1. Download `LXR_OpenElixir-02_V1.0.img` below.
2. Copy it to the top folder of the SD card and delete any other `LXR*.img` files there.
3. Switch the LXR-02 off, insert the card, hold the encoder button and switch it on. Keep holding
   until "LXR Updater" appears.
4. Wait for "Update OK!". The device restarts with the new firmware.

To go back, install the official firmware update from Erica Synths the same way. Kits saved with
OpenElixir-02 keep working there; slots with a different engine play with their stock engine.

The `.hex` and `.elf` files are for programming and debugging with an ST-Link; you don't need them for
a normal update.
